basic_info.name: NHA12D
basic_info.description: NHA12D is a UK pavement crack segmentation dataset containing 80 images (40 asphalt and 40 concrete; 25 top-down and 15 forward/wide-view per surface type) captured by National Highways digital survey vehicles on the A12 road network.

imaging_setup.lighting_conditions: Outdoor pavement scenes with natural illumination variation

annotation_schema.description: Binary crack masks paired with each pavement image

quality_assurance.annotation_quality: Pixel-wise crack masks released by source authors
